1.web: Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.
1.asv: Give ear, O my people, to my law: Incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

2.web: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,
2.asv: I will open my mouth in a parable; I will utter dark sayings of old,

3.web: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
3.asv: Which we have heard and known, And our fathers have told us.

4.web: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and his wondrous works that he has done.
4.asv: We will not hide them from their children, Telling to the generation to come the praises of Jehovah, And his strength, and his wondrous works that he hath done.

5.web: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;
5.asv: For he established a testimony in Jacob, And appointed a law in Israel, Which he commanded our fathers, That they should make them known to their children;

6.web: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,
6.asv: That the generation to come might knowthem, even the children that should be born; Who should arise and tellthemto their children,

7.web: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments,
7.asv: That they might set their hope in God, And not forget the works of God, But keep his commandments,

8.web: and might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.
8.asv: And might not be as their fathers, A stubborn and rebellious generation, A generation that set not their heart aright, And whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

9.web: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
9.asv: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, Turned back in the day of battle.

10.web: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.
10.asv: They kept not the covenant of God, And refused to walk in his law;

11.web: They forgot his doings, his wondrous works that he had shown them.
11.asv: And they forgat his doings, And his wondrous works that he had showed them.

12.web: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
12.asv: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, In the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

13.web: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.
13.asv: He clave the sea, and caused them to pass through; And he made the waters to stand as a heap.

14.web: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.
14.asv: In the day-time also he led them with a cloud, And all the night with a light of fire.

15.web: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.
15.asv: He clave rocks in the wilderness, And gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

16.web: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
16.asv: He brought streams also out of the rock, And caused waters to run down like rivers.

17.web: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.
17.asv: Yet went they on still to sin against him, To rebel against the Most High in the desert.

18.web: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.
18.asv: And they tempted God in their heart By asking food according to their desire.

19.web: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
19.asv: Yea, they spake against God; They said, Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

20.web: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide flesh for his people?”
20.asv: Behold, he smote the rock, so that waters gushed out, And streams overflowed; Can he give bread also? Will he provide flesh for his people?

21.web: Therefore Yahweh heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,
21.asv: Therefore Jehovah heard, and was wroth; And a fire was kindled against Jacob, And anger also went up against Israel;

22.web: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.
22.asv: Because they believed not in God, And trusted not in his salvation.

23.web: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.
23.asv: Yet he commanded the skies above, And opened the doors of heaven;

24.web: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.
24.asv: And he rained down manna upon them to eat, And gave them food from heaven.

25.web: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.
25.asv: Man did eat the bread of the mighty: He sent them food to the full.

26.web: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.
26.asv: He caused the east wind to blow in the heavens; And by his power he guided the south wind.

27.web: He rained also flesh on them as the dust; winged birds as the sand of the seas.
27.asv: He rained flesh also upon them as the dust, And winged birds as the sand of the seas:

28.web: He let them fall in the midst of their camp, around their habitations.
28.asv: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, Round about their habitations.

29.web: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.
29.asv: So they did eat, and were well filled; And he gave them their own desire.

30.web: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,
30.asv: They were not estranged from that which they desired, Their food was yet in their mouths,

31.web: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their fattest, and struck down the young men of Israel.
31.asv: When the anger of God went up against them, And slew of the fattest of them, And smote down the young men of Israel.

32.web: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.
32.asv: For all this they sinned still, And believed not in his wondrous works.

33.web: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.
33.asv: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, And their years in terror.

34.web: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.
34.asv: When he slew them, then they inquired after him; And they returned and sought God earnestly.

35.web: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.
35.asv: And they remembered that God was their rock, And the Most High God their redeemer.

36.web: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.
36.asv: But they flattered him with their mouth, And lied unto him with their tongue.

37.web: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.
37.asv: For their heart was not right with him, Neither were they faithful in his covenant.

38.web: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.
38.asv: But he, being merciful, forgave theiriniquity, and destroyedthemnot: Yea, many a time turned he his anger away, And did not stir up all his wrath.

39.web: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.
39.asv: And he remembered that they were but flesh, A wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

40.web: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!
40.asv: How oft did they rebel against him in the wilderness, And grieve him in the desert!

41.web: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
41.asv: And they turned again and tempted God, And provoked the Holy One of Israel.

42.web: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;
42.asv: They remembered not his hand, Nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

43.web: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,
43.asv: How he set his signs in Egypt, And his wonders in the field of Zoan,

44.web: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.
44.asv: And turned their rivers into blood, And their streams, so that they could not drink.

45.web: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
45.asv: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; And frogs, which destroyed them.

46.web: He gave also their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.
46.asv: He gave also their increase unto the caterpillar, And their labor unto the locust.

47.web: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.
47.asv: He destroyed their vines with hail, And their sycomore-trees with frost.

48.web: He gave over their livestock also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
48.asv: He gave over their cattle also to the hail, And their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

49.web: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.
49.asv: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, Wrath, and indignation, and trouble, A band of angels of evil.

50.web: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,
50.asv: He made a path for his anger; He spared not their soul from death, But gave their life over to the pestilence,

51.web: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.
51.asv: And smote all the first-born in Egypt, The chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

52.web: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
52.asv: But he led forth his own people like sheep, And guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

53.web: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
53.asv: And he led them safely, so that they feared not; But the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

54.web: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.
54.asv: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, To this mountain, which his right hand had gotten.

55.web: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
55.asv: He drove out the nations also before them, And allotted them for an inheritance by line, And made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

56.web: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies;
56.asv: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, And kept not his testimonies;

57.web: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
57.asv: But turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers: They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

58.web: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.
58.asv: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, And moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

59.web: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel;
59.asv: When God heardthis, he was wroth, And greatly abhorred Israel;

60.web: So that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
60.asv: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, The tent which he placed among men;

61.web: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.
61.asv: And delivered his strength into captivity, And his glory into the adversary’s hand.

62.web: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.
62.asv: He gave his people over also unto the sword, And was wroth with his inheritance.

63.web: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.
63.asv: Fire devoured their young men; And their virgins had no marriage-song.

64.web: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.
64.asv: Their priests fell by the sword; And their widows made no lamentation.

65.web: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.
65.asv: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, Like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.

66.web: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.
66.asv: And he smote his adversaries backward: He put them to a perpetual reproach.

67.web: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,
67.asv: Moreover he refused the tent of Joseph, And chose not the tribe of Ephraim,

68.web: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
68.asv: But chose the tribe of Judah, The mount Zion which he loved.

69.web: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.
69.asv: And he built his sanctuary like the heights, Like the earth which he hath established for ever.

70.web: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;
70.asv: He chose David also his servant, And took him from the sheepfolds:

71.web: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.
71.asv: From following the ewes that have their young he brought him, To be the shepherd of Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.

72.web: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
72.asv: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, And guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
